Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform

Location: Remote (US or Canada)
Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 USD plus equity
Employment: Full-time

About the role
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own payment-ledger services used by
every checkout. You will design APIs, review production incidents, and mentor
mid-level engineers.

Must have
- 5+ years of professional backend experience
- Production Python (FastAPI or Django) shipping to production
- PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning
- Experience operating services on Amazon Web Services
- Ability to design distributed systems and reason about consistency

Nice to have
- Kubernetes administration (k8s)
- Terraform
- Prior payments or fintech experience
- Public technical writing

Tech you will use daily: Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, Redis.
We are a remote-first team. No agencies.
